name: paper-crumple
title: Paper Crumple
description: An image on a 3D paper sheet that crumples in your hand as you hold and drag it, the folds catching the light, then springs back flat when released.
use: A portfolio or campaign wants a playful, tactile image that reacts to a press and drag.
avoid: The crumple is a heavy 3D physics scene, needs a sized canvas area, and remote images must allow CORS.
a11y: Space, arrow keys and Escape operate it, but the focus outline is removed and only a tiny dot appears instead. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A portrait photo of a mountain range above clouds, printed edge to edge on a sheet with a slight paper texture and soft drop shadow. Mid-gesture it balls up into a wrinkled, faceted clump with the image wrapped around the folds.
behaves: Pressing and dragging pushes the sheet into itself, buckling the image into creases and a rounded clump that follows the pointer and tilts as it is thrown. Releasing lets it smooth back into a flat photo.
customise: Source and back image, alt, width, height, fit, release behaviour, crumple amount and durations, fold count, wrinkle depth, paper colour and texture, lighting, shadow, drag and rotation are props.
weight: heavy: A three.js mesh with a CPU paper simulation and shadow-mapped lights runs during the gesture.
